questions.category: D1: Diagnose and repair cooling systems
questions.question: An engine overheats mostly at idle, but temperature drops when driving. What is the most likely cause?
options: Poor radiator airflow or cooling fan fault
questions.explanation: At idle, airflow depends heavily on the cooling fan. If the fan, relay, fuse, sensor, or wiring fails, the engine may overheat when stopped.

questions.category: D2: Diagnose and repair lubricating systems
questions.question: The oil pressure warning light comes on at hot idle. What should be checked first?
questions.explanation: Never assume the warning light is only a sensor fault. Check oil level and verify actual oil pressure.

questions.category: D3: Diagnose and repair engine assembly
questions.question: A compression test shows one cylinder much lower than the others. What should be done next?
questions.explanation: A leak-down test helps identify whether compression is lost through valves, rings, head gasket, or cylinder damage.

questions.category: D4: Diagnose and repair accessory drive systems
questions.question: A serpentine belt has cracks and missing ribs. What should be done?
questions.explanation: Cracked or damaged belts can slip or fail, affecting alternator, water pump, A/C, or power steering operation.

questions.category: H2: Diagnose and repair manual transmissions and transaxles
questions.question: A manual transmission grinds when shifting into one gear only. What is likely?
questions.explanation: Synchronizers match gear speed during shifts. Grinding in one gear often points to that gear’s synchronizer.
